prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A close-up, macro shot of luxurious tan leather upholstery, showcasing intricate diagonal stitching and a pattern of small, evenly spaced perforations. The leather surface is softly illuminated with warm, natural light, highlighting the subtle texture and gentle sheen of the material. The composition emphasizes the tactile quality and craftsmanship, with shallow depth of field creating a smooth, blurred background that draws attention to the sharp details of the stitching and perforations. The color palette consists of rich caramel and beige tones, evoking a sense of elegance and comfort. The overall style is refined and modern, reminiscent of high-end automotive or designer furniture photography, with a focus on material quality and sophisticated design.
